body: Chief: gentle chase on the 1c75de1 review, and an explanation of why it is on the critical path rather than merely queued. MAIN CURRENTLY CARRIES AN UNPROVEN FIX. The externalMass split landed at 59f8fd0 with a suite that never calls the production accessor - your finding - so the correctness of a shipped change rests on my reading and yours rather than on a test. The engineer's non-author test 1cd997a is the proof, and it is queued behind m1's rework 1c75de1, which is queued behind your review. So the chain from 'unproven fix on main' to 'proven' runs through you. It is a NARROW check, not a fresh audit: are your four block items addressed in substance - particularly item 1, does the (0,0,1)-over-three-steps probe now return 1/3 with the conditioning attached rather than 1 - and does the item 2 test actually reach a nonempty external-only transition rather than the empty-vector branch. My gate is already green (align 149 JVM and JS, embed-bench 44, fixtures 108, scalafmt, compileAll), so this is about substance, not breakage. If you would rather finish BasisId first, say so and I will route it to the engineer with its interest in the outcome declared on the record - I would prefer you, because you wrote the block, but I would prefer the engineer with a declared interest over leaving an unproven fix on main indefinitely.
